newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Al Hafizu loading 13,500 tonnes bagged sugar. Achilles loading 25,000 tonnes using big bags. Maria P.I. loading 12,600 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, five vessels to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk.
Road: 155 trucks carrying sugar arrived on July 3.

Vessels: Alan, Fratziz, Daiana P, Tong Cheng, Fulvia and Efrem each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Ar Raqib loading 14,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Tern loading 28,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Jurata loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, five vessels to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk. At Cargill private
